summary: Phase-5 Iteration-2 Venue Expansion testing complete. All 34 backend tests passed (venue CRUD, validate endpoint with required params, user options, access check). Frontend verified: Admin Exchanges page renders with full CRUD for exchanges/capabilities/allowed-markets/user-assignments; User Exchange Settings page has venue selectors in Risk Settings and Test & Validation tabs; venue access check works after admin assignment.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 404 errors for favicon/static assets during page load - not API failures

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/exchange/validate now correctly REQUIRES exchange, market_type, environment query params (returns 422 if missing)
Validate response contract includes all required fields: exchange, market_type, environment, capability_match, reason_codes
User venue assignment upsert works correctly - admin can assign users to venues
User venue options endpoint returns filtered list based on assignments and allowed markets
No regression on existing key save, readiness cards, and test-order blocked state when key invalid/missing
seed_data_creation: User venue assignment created for TEST_phase4iter4@example.com to binance (spot+futures, testnet)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-5 Iteration-2 venue expansion features fully tested. Admin CRUD for exchanges/capabilities/allowed-markets/user-assignments all working. GET /api/exchange/validate requires exchange+market_type+environment params. User venue selectors exist in Risk Settings and Test & Validation tabs. Test user assigned to binance venue - access check shows venue_ready. No PostgreSQL/MongoDB issues found.

admin_exchanges_crud.list_exchanges: GET /api/venues/admin/exchanges returns list with binance seeded
admin_exchanges_crud.create_exchange: POST /api/venues/admin/exchanges creates new exchange (tested with TEST_kraken)

admin_capabilities_crud.list_capabilities: GET /api/venues/admin/capabilities returns list with binance spot+futures

exchange_validate_endpoint.requires_exchange_param: Returns 422 when exchange query param missing
exchange_validate_endpoint.requires_market_type_param: Returns 422 when market_type query param missing
exchange_validate_endpoint.requires_environment_param: Returns 422 when environment query param missing
exchange_validate_endpoint.response_contract: Includes exchange, market_type, environment, capability_match, reason_codes

user_venue_endpoints.venue_options: GET /api/venues/options returns filtered venue options based on user assignments
user_venue_endpoints.access_check: GET /api/venues/access-check returns allowed, venue_state, capability_match, reason_codes

frontend_ui.admin_exchanges_page: Full CRUD UI for exchanges, capabilities, allowed markets, user assignments
frontend_ui.user_test_validation_tab: Venue selectors present, venue access panel shows real-time access check
frontend_ui.test_order_blocked_state: Properly shows awaiting_valid_key when credentials invalid

no_regression.test_order_blocked: POST /api/exchange/test-order returns 400 with failure_code when invalid

mocked_api_note: No mocked APIs for venue CRUD - all endpoints are real PostgreSQL operations
